types.embedding_query_text: Technology: A tool or system that uses artificial intelligence to perform tasks. Also called AI system, Machine learning model, Automation tool. Examples: Artificial intelligence, AI.

chosen_type.label: ArtificialIntelligenceSystem
chosen_type.definition: A system that uses artificial intelligence to perform tasks.
chosen_type.justification: No existing schema.org type perfectly matches the definition and mentions.

candidates.label: SoftwareApplication
candidates.comment: A computer program designed to perform specific tasks for a user. Also called application, app, computer program, software. Examples: Microsoft Word, Adobe Photoshop, a mobile game, a web browser.

candidates.label: TechArticle
candidates.comment: An article providing technical information, such as how-to guides, troubleshooting steps, or specifications. Also called technical guide, how-to article, procedural document, specification. Examples: an article on 'How to install Linux', a troubleshooting guide for a software error, a specification document for a new API.

candidates.label: ComputerLanguage
candidates.comment: A formal language used for computer programming or other computer representations. Also called programming language, coding language, machine language. Examples: Python, Java, C++, SQL, HTML, XML. Distinct from Language, which refers to natural human languages.

candidates.label: DefinedTermSet
candidates.comment: A creative work representing a collection of formally defined terms, such as a glossary, dictionary, or classification scheme. Also called Glossary, vocabulary, taxonomy, thesaurus, enumeration. Examples: The Dewey Decimal Classification system, a medical dictionary, a list of product categories, a set of industry standards. Distinct from DefinedTerm, which is a single entry within such a set.

candidates.label: DigitalPlatformEnumeration
candidates.comment: An enumeration listing common technology platforms, used to specify where an action or content is available. Also called Technology platform, software platform, operating system, device type. Examples: iOS, Android, Web, Desktop, Console. Distinct from SoftwareApplication, which is the application itself, not the platform it runs on.

types.embedding_query_text: GovernmentAgency: An organization that is responsible for collecting and analyzing data for the government. Also called Bureau, Department, Administration. Examples: U.S. Census Bureau, Census Bureau.

chosen_type.label: GovernmentOrganization
chosen_type.justification: Best match for the definition and mention of a government agency.

candidates.label: GovernmentOrganization
candidates.comment: A GovernmentOrganization is an organization or agency that is part of a governmental body. Also called public sector entity, state agency, governmental body. Examples: Department of Defense, Environmental Protection Agency, National Institutes of Health, local city council.

candidates.label: GovernmentOffice
candidates.comment: A GovernmentOffice is a local business representing a specific governmental agency or department. Also called public agency office, state department branch, municipal service center. Examples: IRS office, DMV office, local planning department, social security office. Distinct from GovernmentBuilding, which is the physical structure that may contain multiple offices.

candidates.label: FundingAgency
candidates.comment: A FundingAgency is an Organization that implements FundingSchemes and manages the granting process for projects and activities. Also called grant agency, funding body, research council. Examples: National Institutes of Health (NIH), European Research Council (ERC), Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.

candidates.label: GovernmentService
candidates.comment: A GovernmentService is an intangible service provided by a government organization to the public. Also called public service, state-provided service, municipal offering. Examples: food stamps program, veterans benefits, public education, waste collection.

candidates.label: EmploymentAgency
candidates.comment: An EmploymentAgency is a LocalBusiness that helps individuals find jobs and employers find suitable candidates. Also called recruitment agency, staffing firm, job placement service. Examples: A temporary staffing agency, an executive search firm, a headhunting company.

types.embedding_query_text: OccupationalGroup: A group of people who work in a particular profession or industry. Also called Profession, Industry, Workforce. Examples: workers, employees, economists.

chosen_type.label: ProfessionalGroup
chosen_type.definition: A group of people who work in a particular profession or industry.
chosen_type.justification: No existing schema.org type perfectly matches the definition and mentions.

candidates.label: Occupation
candidates.comment: An Occupation is a profession that may involve prolonged training and/or a formal qualification. Also called profession, job, career. Examples: doctor, engineer, teacher, artist. Distinct from Role, which describes a specific function within an organization or context.

candidates.label: MusicGroup
candidates.comment: A MusicGroup, as a PerformingGroup, is an organization of musicians, such as a band or orchestra, or a solo musician. Also called band, musical ensemble, orchestra, solo artist. Examples: The Beatles, New York Philharmonic, Taylor Swift. Distinct from PerformingGroup, which is a broader category for any performance group.

candidates.label: PerformingGroup
candidates.comment: A PerformingGroup is an organization of performers, such as a band, orchestra, or circus. Also called performance ensemble, troupe, artistic group. Examples: Cirque du Soleil, a local theatre company, a dance troupe. Distinct from MusicGroup, which is specifically for musical performers.

candidates.label: TheaterGroup
candidates.comment: An organization or company dedicated to producing and performing theatrical works. Also called theater company, drama troupe, acting ensemble. Examples: The Royal Shakespeare Company, Cirque du Soleil, a local amateur dramatics society.

candidates.label: WorkersUnion
candidates.comment: An organization that advocates for the interests of its worker members through collective bargaining and political lobbying. Also called labor union, trade union, industrial union. Examples: United Auto Workers (UAW), National Education Association (NEA), a local plumbers' union.

types.embedding_query_text: EducationalInstitution: An organization that provides education and research opportunities. Also called University, College, Institute. Examples: Massachusetts Institute of Technology, MIT.

chosen_type.label: EducationalOrganization
chosen_type.justification: Best match for the definition and mention of an educational institution.

candidates.label: School
candidates.comment: An educational organization providing instruction to students, typically for primary or secondary education. Also called educational institution, academy, learning center, college. Examples: a public elementary school, a private high school, a vocational school, a university.

candidates.label: EducationalOrganization
candidates.comment: An EducationalOrganization is a CivicStructure that provides education. Also called learning institution, academic body, school. Examples: A university, a high school, a vocational college, a research institute.

candidates.label: CollegeOrUniversity
candidates.comment: A third-level educational institution providing higher education. Also called university, college, higher education institution. Examples: Harvard University, Oxford College, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Sorbonne University. Distinct from EducationalOrganization, which is a broader category for any educational body.

candidates.label: EducationalOccupationalProgram
candidates.comment: An EducationalOccupationalProgram is an Intangible program offered by an institution that defines the learning path to achieve an outcome, such as a credential or new occupational opportunity. Also called academic program, training course, career pathway. Examples: A Master's degree program in engineering, a vocational training program for electricians, a coding bootcamp, a nursing school curriculum.

candidates.label: ResearchOrganization
candidates.comment: A ResearchOrganization is an Organization dedicated to conducting research. Also called scientific institute, research company, academic research center. Examples: Max Planck Society, Bell Labs, a university research department, a pharmaceutical research firm.

chosen_type.label: EconomicModel
chosen_type.definition: A theoretical framework used to understand and predict economic behavior.
chosen_type.justification: No existing schema.org type perfectly matches the definition and mentions.

candidates.label: 3DModel
candidates.comment: A 3DModel, as a MediaObject under CreativeWork, represents some kind of three-dimensional content, which may have various digital encodings. Also called 3D content, digital model, virtual model. Examples: A CAD file of an engine part, a character model for a video game, a geospatial terrain model, an architectural rendering.

candidates.label: ProductModel
candidates.comment: A ProductModel is a Product representing a datasheet or vendor specification of a prototypical product description. Also called product prototype, product specification, product blueprint. Examples: the technical specifications for a new laptop model, a design document for a car engine, a vendor's product data sheet, a conceptual product design.

candidates.label: MonetaryAmountDistribution
candidates.comment: A quantitative value distribution representing a statistical distribution of monetary amounts. Also called money distribution, financial range, income distribution. Examples: "average salary range", "distribution of asset values", "price range for a product category".

candidates.label: DatedMoneySpecification
candidates.comment: A structured value representing a monetary amount that is valid or applicable over a specified time period, though its use is superseded by MonetaryAmount. Also called Time-bound monetary value, period-specific money, dated financial amount. Examples: An employee's salary from 2022-01-01 to 2022-12-31, a subscription fee valid for a quarter, a bonus paid for a specific fiscal year.

candidates.label: MedicalRiskCalculator
candidates.comment: A medical risk estimator that is a complex mathematical calculation, often requiring an online tool, used to assess prognosis. Also called prognosis calculator, risk assessment tool, clinical prediction model. Examples: a calculator for cardiovascular disease risk, a tool for predicting cancer recurrence. Distinct from MedicalRiskScore, which is a simpler sum of risk factors.
